metadata.title: Kaspa Developer Docs, SDKs, APIs, and Node Access | Kaspa
metadata.description: Everything you need to start building on Kaspa. Mainnet programmability, WASM SDK, Rust libraries, live API playground, node access, and developer tooling.

start.heading: Build on {kaspa}
start.description: Mainnet programmability, {wasmSdk}, native {rust} libraries, and node infrastructure for building on {kaspa}.

quickstart.title: Start building
quickstart.descriptionWithAi: Use {kaspaAi} for direction, then jump into the route that matches what you need.
quickstart.descriptionWithoutAi: Start with the docs, live examples, or node route that matches what you need.
quickstart.aiDescription: Get pointed to the right {sdk}, {api}, node, or programmability path.

heading.label: Try live
heading.title: Run the {rustyKaspa} browser examples
heading.description: The examples below are served from the {rustyKaspaVersion} browser {sdk} release, so you can see the {sdk} behave without leaving the page.

tryLive.networkNotice: Runs against the <network>{publicNodeNetwork}</network>, a decentralized pool of community-operated nodes fronted by the {kaspaResolver}. May take a few seconds to initialize, and is not recommended for large-scale production use.

serverInfo.title: Get server info
serverInfo.description: Connect through the public resolver and fetch basic node information directly from the browser.

dagInfo.title: Get block {dag} info
dagInfo.description: Read high-level {dag} state from a live {kaspa} node using the upstream browser {rpc} bindings.

blockAdded.title: Watch new blocks
blockAdded.description: Subscribe to block-added events and watch blocks arrive in real time from the browser.

daaChanged.title: Watch {daa} changes
daaChanged.description: Subscribe to {daa} score updates and watch the stream change in real time.

utxoContext.title: Track a {utxo} context
utxoContext.description: Use the core browser bindings to monitor an address and receive live {utxo} events.

heading.label: Paths
heading.title: Choose your path
heading.description: Choose an integration stack, node setup, or programmability model for the system you're building.

wasm.title: Build with the {wasmSdk}
wasm.description: Use the upstream browser and {nodeJs} bindings for wallet flows, transactions, and {rpc} access.

rust.title: Build with native {rust}
rust.description: Use the {rust} crates inside {rustyKaspa} for backend services, systems integrations, wallet internals, and node-adjacent workloads.

programmability.title: Build programmable apps
programmability.description: Compare {covenants}, {basedApps}, and specialist {inlineZk}. {fullVprogs} remain the future direction for composition between independent apps.

node.title: Run a node
node.description: Use {rustyKaspa} for full access, {utxo} indexing, and production infrastructure.

communityApi.label: Community {api}
communityApi.description: For quick reads or constrained environments, a community-hosted {api} is available. Best-effort, no SLA.

heading.label: Node
heading.title: Run a node
heading.description: Spin up {rustyKaspa} locally with {docker}. For a persistent setup, check {dockerHub} or build from source.

runNode.title: Run the latest {rustyKaspa} image
runNode.description: Exposes {grpc} on port 16110 so you can talk to the node from your dev machine. Ephemeral container — no persistent storage or inbound {p2p}.

heading.label: Tooling
heading.title: Current toolchain
heading.description: The stable surfaces builders can rely on today, with emerging work called out separately.

rustyKaspa.title: {rustyKaspa}
rustyKaspa.description: {rust} crates, wallet internals, full node, {rpc}, indexing, and direct network access.

wasm.title: {wasmSdk}
wasm.description: Upstream browser and {node} bindings for applications, wallets, and transaction flows.

python.title: {pythonSdk}
python.description: Nearly complete. Usable today if {python} is part of your stack.

community.title: Ecosystem tools and infra
community.description: Open-source projects from the broader {kaspa} ecosystem that complement the upstream {sdk} and node stack.

indexer.title: {simplyKaspaIndexer}
indexer.description: Standalone indexing for {kaspa} block and transaction data.

dnsSeeder.title: {dnsSeeder}
dnsSeeder.description: Bootstrapping infrastructure for the {kaspa} peer-to-peer network.

khost.title: {khost}
khost.description: Tooling for running and contributing node capacity to the wider ecosystem.

heading.label: Access
heading.title: Network access
heading.description: Docs, query surfaces, node references, and test flows grouped by what builders actually need.

docs.title: Docs
docs.description: Start with the guides, technical references, and open proposals.

query.title: Query and access
query.description: Query the network through public tools and the lightweight community-hosted {api}. The community {api} is best-effort with no SLA.

node.title: Node and {rpc}
node.description: Run full infrastructure or go deeper into the node stack.

testnet.title: Testnet
testnet.description: Use public testing resources before shipping to mainnet.

heading.label: Developments
heading.title: Follow the work in public
heading.description: Separate the consensus capabilities live on mainnet from the builder tooling and research that are still evolving.

channel.label: Channel
channel.title: Core R&D {telegram}
channel.description: The main public stream for current {kaspa} research and development discussions. {discord} is still used, but most core discussion now happens here.

research.label: Forum
research.title: {kaspaResearch}
research.description: Long-form forum for protocol, consensus, economics, and mining discussion, plus {kip} drafts and proposals.

kasSmiths.label: Community
kasSmiths.title: {kasSmiths}: builders' workshop
kasSmiths.description: Discuss and refine {kaspa} standards, protocols, tooling, shared infrastructure, and product ideas with other builders.

toccata.label: Live on mainnet
toccata.title: {toccata} programmability
toccata.description: {toccata} added programmable UTXOs to {kaspa} through covenants, transaction introspection, ZK verification, and sequencing support for based apps. It has been live on mainnet since June 30, 2026.

silverscript.label: Covenant tooling
silverscript.title: {silverscript}
silverscript.description: The primary higher-level authoring path for mainnet covenants, compiling to native {kaspaScript}. Tooling is still early; check current release and audit status before production use.

vprogs.label: In construction
vprogs.title: {vprogs}: Based Apps
vprogs.description: The shared-state application path is under construction. The vProgs runtime is an evolving source of patterns, not yet a stable external developer API; Full vProgs remain a future direction.

python.label: {sdk}
python.title: {pythonSdk}
python.description: In beta and nearly complete. {python} tooling is progressing in the open and expanding the developer surface.

kips.label: Protocol
kips.title: {kips}
kips.description: Track proposals that can change how applications and infrastructure integrate with the network.

help.title: Keep moving
help.descriptionWithAi: Start with the docs or {kaspaAi}. For deeper help, try the {qa}, {github}, {discord}, or the R&D {telegram}.
help.descriptionWithoutAi: Start with the docs. For deeper help, try the {qa}, {github}, {discord}, or the R&D {telegram}.
